messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: High tail latency observed for customer HelioBank (single-tenant) on model rdx-13b-stream. p95 ~ 220ms (ok), p99 ~ 2.1s (breach), streaming stalls reported. Trace-id sample: trace::hb-9a3f

Ben (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Is this across all regions or just us-east-1?

Alice (sre): From metrics: affects only the HelioBank dedicated pool in us-east-1. Tail spikes correlate with prompt size > 4k tokens and high concurrency from a small subset of API keys. p50/p95 unchanged, p99 and streaming stall rate up ~5x.

Carla (platform): We are seeing many long-lived streaming connections (up to 60s). Batching pressure goes up, KV cache eviction increases. Kernel busy % on the affected workers jumps to 95% during spikes.

Ben (oncall): Can someone paste the recent deploys/rollouts? Might be rollout-related.

devops-bot: Deploybot: No model-serving deploys to the HelioBank pool in the last 24h. Autoscaler changed replica target at 01:12UTC (policy tweak).

Alice (sre): Looks like autoscaler target decreased temporarily due to a mis-evaluated metric. I can force a scale to +3 replicas in the dedicated pool to relieve queuing.

Sam (ml): Adding context: HelioBank uses a slightly modified prompt wrapper that appends a long policy preamble (customer-managed). That increases KV cache footprint and makes every request cold on first pass. Combined with concurrency burst they hit the worst-case attention path.

Liza (cs): HelioBank reports timeouts from their app at ~2s on the streaming connection. They asked if we changed anything; they have an upcoming demo. They are currently rate-limiting client-side to 80 qps but still see spikes.

Ben (oncall): Short-term mitigations: 1) Scale dedicated pool +3 replicas (Alice) 2) Enable model-variant fallback to rdx-6b-quant for HelioBank route (Sam) 3) Apply short-lived routing throttle to HelioBank API key (Carla) 4) Notify customer.

Alice (sre): Running scale command now:
```
# increase replica count for helio-dedicated-pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/helio-dedicated-pool --replicas=8
```
Alice (sre): Scale in flight, ETA ~ 90s for healthy pods to accept traffic.

Carla (platform): Applying routing throttle rule to cap concurrency to 200 for the HelioBank route while we stabilize.

Carla (platform): Throttle applied. Routing now shards excess to a cheap fallback pool and returns 429 when over-constrained (will log for audit).

Sam (ml): Enabling fallback policy to route 10% of traffic to rdx-6b-quant for canary validation. Command:
```
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --customer helio --from rdx-13b-stream --to rdx-6b-quant --rate 10%
```
Sam (ml): Canaries are up. Initial latency p99 for fallback is 650ms. Quality evals within expected delta for a small set of prompts.

Ben (oncall): Good. Alice did scale show queue depths?

Alice (sre): Queue depths dropped ~60% after the extra replicas came up. KV eviction rate still elevated but stabilizing. Streaming stalls decreased from 5/min to ~1/min.

Liza (cs): Informing HelioBank support: "We've applied temporary throttling and added capacity; we're also validating a fallback model. You may see slightly different outputs for a small percent of requests during the canary. We'll keep you posted."

HelioBank (via Liza): Customer replied: "Thanks — please avoid any breaking changes. We'll postpone the demo by ~1h if needed."

Carla (platform): Observability snapshot (snip):
```
- affected pool: helio-dedicated-pool
- p95 before: 180ms, p99 before: 2.1s
- p95 after scale: 170ms, p99 after scale+throttle: 750ms
- streaming stall rate: 5/min -> 1/min
- KV cache hits: 18% -> 35% (warming)
```

Alice (sre): Root cause hypothesis: long prompt preambles + high concurrency cause repeated KV cold starts and heavy attention compute, producing tail queuing/stalls. Autoscaler mis-eval reduced headroom which amplified the effect.

Sam (ml): Short-term action items (already mostly done): - scale pool +3 - fallback canary 10% - throttle concurrency - contact customer, advise app-side backoff

Ben (oncall): Medium-term: 1) Add prompt-size-aware routing (large prompts to larger-instance pool) 2) Fix autoscaler metric (thresholds and burst policy) 3) Add prefix-KV prewarmed layer for HelioBank 4) Postmortem and customer RCA.

Carla (platform): I'll file a tracking ticket for autoscaler fix and prompt-aware routing. Assigning to infra-team.

Alice (sre): Will keep monitoring for 30m. If p99 stays <900ms and stalls <1/min we can resolve incident.

devops-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Ben (oncall). Severity: sev2 -> monitoring.

Ben (oncall): Thanks all. I'll stay on this for the next hour then hand off to Alice for runbook and postmortem write-up.

Sam (ml): I'll run a curated eval set across rdx-6b-quant canary to surface any regressions and post results in the ticket.

Liza (cs): I'll update the customer channel with a short summary and ETA for RCA by EOD.

Alice (sre): p99 currently 720ms, stalls trending down. Marking mitigation as successful for now.

Ben (oncall): Closing loop — if anything regresses @channel please @Ben (oncall) and escalate. Will file postmortem template.

Carla (platform): Created infra ticket INFRA-5872: "Autoscaler threshold bug -> tighten metric windows + add burst target" and linked the canary results.

Sam (ml): Posted quick eval snapshot to ticket: small drop in some instruction-following tests, will prepare more thorough evals.

Alice (sre): Handing off to Alice for postmortem draft. Ben stepping out.

Ben (oncall): Handing off. :white_check_mark:
